async function run(items, step) {
	await inOrder(items, step, {
		reason: "Each write depends on the prior transaction",
	});
	await inOrder(items, step, {
		reason: `Each write depends on the prior transaction`,
	});
	const reason = "Each write depends on the prior transaction";
	await inOrder(items, step, { reason });
	await inOrderSteps([step, step], { reason });
}
